_meta.description: FAA airport Locid -> the county (FIPS) its coordinates fall in. The join key between candidates.json and Census county population.
_meta.source: US Census Geocoder (geocoding.geo.census.gov), coordinates -> Counties layer
_meta.unresolved_note: Airports whose coordinates fall outside any US county polygon -- expected for territories the Census county layer does not cover (Guam, American Samoa, N. Mariana Is.). These simply get no population fields; they are not dropped from candidates.json.
